description:
Welcome to Bubble Town Garage – the happiest car wash in town! Wash, fix, paint and drive 16 adorable vehicles with real faces: they giggle when you scrub them, blush when they get stickers and cheer when they shine.

520 LEVELS TO PLAY
Bubble Town has 520 different levels across 10 colorful worlds, from Bubble Square and Farm Road to Snowy Hill, Night City and the Race Track.

WASH
• Scrub away mud, sand, snow, paint splats, berries and oil
• Spray fluffy foam and pop the rainbow bubbles
• Drive through the giggly brush tunnel
• Rinse, blow-dry and polish until everything sparkles

FIX
• Change flat tires with a jack and a wrench
• Match engine parts to their shapes – battery, gears, spark plugs and more
• Hammer out dents, glue cracked windows, top up oil and fuel

DESIGN
• Spray paint with 10 colors, add stripes, flames, stars, hearts or glitter
• Decorate with stickers, choose new wheels, sirens, roof toys and spoilers

DRIVE
• Take every clean vehicle on a mission in town: put out fires with the fire truck, carry patients in the ambulance, deliver ice cream, dig for treasure with the digger, tow broken cars, race and fly through rings
• Collect stars along the way

MORE TO DISCOVER
• Police car, ambulance, fire truck, school bus, tractor, digger, cement mixer, garbage truck, tow truck, monster truck, race car, ice cream van, train, helicopter and airplane
• Garage collection with 50+ characters you keep and customise
• A Daily Surprise vehicle with glitter and gold
• Stickers to collect, coins to earn, 1–3 stars on every level

MADE FOR LITTLE HANDS
• No reading needed – a glowing hand shows what to do
• Simple taps and swipes, no fail states, no timers
• Plays offline after the first launch
• Parental gate in front of purchases and settings
• Original music and sound effects

Designed for kids aged 2–6, boys and girls, toddlers and preschoolers.

Seven worlds (364 levels) are free to play. Car Wash Kids Premium is an optional monthly subscription: while it is active, all packs and levels are unlocked and there are no ads. Unlock All and three premium packs (Monster, Rescue, Racing) are optional one-time purchases. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage them at account.microsoft.com/services.

Privacy Policy: https://mucobulut.github.io/oyunlar-destek/carwash/privacy/
short: New: 520 levels, 16 giggly vehicles and a brush tunnel full of rainbow bubbles!
